name: dan-work-routing
description: Classify work before doing it: a safety constraint governs where one applies, cost governs everything else, never a blend. Carries the cost ordering, when to spawn a sub-agent, and how to handle secrets.

top_tier_concurrency.title: Top-tier agents in flight
top_tier_concurrency.description: How many top-tier sub-agents may run at once across the session. The spawner and its ancestors are not counted. 0 lifts the limit.

agent_width.title: Agents in flight, any tier
agent_width.description: How many sub-agents may run at once in total. 0 lifts the limit.

nested_top_tier_budget.title: Top-tier helpers per sub-agent
nested_top_tier_budget.description: How many top-tier agents one sub-agent — a fork, a review — may spawn in total, finished ones included. The root session is not budgeted. 0 lifts the limit.

nested_agent_budget.title: Helpers per sub-agent, any tier
nested_agent_budget.description: How many agents one sub-agent — a fork, a review — may spawn in total, finished ones included, whatever their tier. The root session is not budgeted. 0 lifts the limit.

idle_minutes.title: Silence before an agent counts as gone
idle_minutes.description: Minutes without a transcript write after which a sub-agent with no terminal stop is taken for killed. 0 never expires one.
